rules.venues: EXACT_MATCH and COMPARABLE_EXCEPT_EXCEPTIONS quotes (rule hashes re-checked at read time). Anything else related is listed in related[] with its own native price, never compared.
rules.comparison: >= 2 numeric quotes, neither stale, observed_at within 120 s of each other (our read clock); match_class names the class (EXACT_MATCH or COMPARABLE_EXCEPT_EXCEPTIONS, never pooled). No consensus number. venue_disagreement threshold 5 pts.
rules.freshness: live / delayed / stale by our read time vs each lane cadence; withdrawn after 30 min (Predictions-captured Kalshi quotes: 75 min).
rules.pbe: Public PBE forecasts only (non-sports: RESEARCH / VALIDATED / OFFICIAL; sports: frozen Algo-vs-Market pick probability, Pro picks hidden until resolved).
rules.comparable: COMPARABLE_EXCEPT_EXCEPTIONS quotes carry `disclosure` ("Postponement/cancellation settlement rules differ between venues"; soccer: "Normal 90-minute result rules match. Postponement, cancellation and fallback settlement rules differ between venues.") and are numbers only while the game is scheduled normally (withdrawn on postponement, cancellation or a missed start). Never pooled with EXACT_MATCH (comparison.match_class).
rules.related: related[] = venue markets whose rules differ (label "RELATED MARKET · RULES DIFFER"): native price + freshness + reason; never a gap, never compared.
rules.archive: Venue numbers are PropBetEdge timestamped observations of public API reads.
